diagrams.class_diagram:
classDiagram
    class Case {
        -String caseId
        -String status
        -DateTime createdDate
        -DateTime lastAccessed
        -String title
        -String description
        -DateTime createdAt
        +register()
        +investigate()
        +prosecute()
    }
    class Suspect {
        -String suspectId
        -String name
        -String status
        -String description
        +addToCase()
        +updateStatus()
    }
    class Property {
        -String propertyId
        -String description
        -Decimal value
        -String status
        +assignToCase()
        +updateValue()
    }
    class AuditTrail {
        -String eventId
        -String eventType
        -DateTime timestamp
        -String userId
        -String auditId
        -String action
        -String entityType
        -String entityId
        -String details
        +logEvent()
        +exportEvents()
    }
    class UserProfile {
        -String userId
        -String role
        -Object uiPreferences
        -Object preferences
        -String username
        -List groups
        -String name
        -List groupMemberships
        +createProfile()
        +updatePermissions()
    }
    class Defect {
        -String defectId
        -String description
        -String status
        -String priority
        -DateTime createdAt
        -String title
        -String reportedBy
        -DateTime reportedAt
        -String category
        +logDefect()
        +updateStatus()
    }
    class Document {
        -String documentId
        -String type
        -Object content
        -String title
        -DateTime createdAt
        -String name
        -Long size
        -DateTime uploadedAt
        +upload()
        +download()
    }
    Case "1" --> "*" Suspect : contains
    Case "1" --> "*" Property : involves
    Case "1" --> "*" Document : has
    Case "1" --> "*" AuditTrail : tracks
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" Case : assigned
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" AuditTrail : performs
    UserProfile "1" --> "*" Defect : reports
    Suspect "1" --> "1" Case : belongs_to
    Property "1" --> "1" Case : belongs_to
    Document "1" --> "1" Case : associated_with
    AuditTrail "1" --> "1" Case : related_to
    Defect "1" --> "1" UserProfile : created_by
